_comment: Malay phrase appended to the section heading above each undescribed image, one per article. The heading names WHAT the image is placed against; the phrase says what that section is. Nothing here claims what the photograph shows, because nobody has looked at these 172 photographs. Every phrase has been through the humanizer.
